red.title: Imirire mibi ikabije
red.action: Umujyanama w'ubuzima yohereza umwana kuvurwa uwo munsi. Ikibondo gishyira umwana mu bafite ibyago byinshi kandi kikamenyesha umuforomo.

yellow.title: Imirire mibi yoroheje
yellow.action: Umwana ahabwa indyo y'inyongera kandi akongera gupimwa ku gusura gukurikira. Ikibondo giteganya gukurikirana.

green.title: Nta mirire mibi
green.action: Umwana arakura neza. Umujyanama w'ubuzima akomeza gusura nk'uko bisanzwe.

muac.note: Ibipimo bya OMS ku bana bafite amezi 6 kugeza kuri 59. MUAC ni kimwe mu bipimo: kubyimba ibirenge n'ibiro ugereranyije n'uburebure nabyo birasuzumwa.

notes.1: Yongera ibiro neza, hafi y'umurongo wo hagati.
notes.4: Ibiro byagabanutse kuva ku gusura guheruka. Ikibondo kimenyesha ko akeneye ubufasha, umujyanama w'ubuzima akamwohereza ku muforomo.
notes.5: Yahawe indyo y'inyongera nyuma yo koherezwa. Yongeye kwiyongera ibiro.
notes.6: Yagarutse hafi y'umurongo we wa mbere.

growthChart.title: Ibiro by'umwana ku mbonerahamwe y'imikurire ya OMS
growthChart.desc: Umwana akurikira umurongo wo hagati kugeza ku kwezi kwa 6, akamanuka agana kuri −2 SD ku kwezi kwa 8, akoherezwa kwa muganga, maze akagaruka hafi y'umurongo wo hagati ku kwezi kwa 15.
growthChart.hint: Kanda ku gusura kuri iyi mbonerahamwe urebe ibyo umujyanama w'ubuzima yanditse.
growthChart.caption: Ibiro ugereranyije n'imyaka, abakobwa bafite amezi 0 kugeza kuri 24. Ni urugero; amabara akurikira hafi ibipimo by'imikurire bya OMS.

meta.homeDescription: Gukurikirana imirire n'ubuzima bw'abana mu nkambi z'impunzi mu Rwanda. Bifasha abajyanama b'ubuzima kumenya kare abana bafite ibyago by'imirire mibi.
meta.aboutDescription: Impamvu Ikibondo cyabayeho n'uko gifasha abakozi b'ubuzima mu nkambi z'impunzi mu Rwanda kumenya kare abana bafite imirire mibi.
